author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Cronenworth goes deep Tuesday
desc: Jake Cronenworth went 1-for-3 with a home run and three RBI in the Padres 4-1 win over the Diamondbacks on Friday.
impact: Cronenworth blasted a three-run home run in the first inning that wound up making the difference in the game for San Diego. He is still slashing just .183/.285/.270 with three home runs and 10 RBI on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Miller earns save Tuesday
desc: Mason Miller worked a clean inning on Tuesday against the Diamondbacks for his 23rd save.
impact: Miller needed just 14 pitches to go along with two strikeouts. He remains one of the most dominant closers in baseball. He just hasn't seen many save chances recently.

author: Ari Koslow
title: German Marquez earns win Tuesday
desc: German Marquez allowed one (unearned) run on three hits over five innings with four strikeouts and three walks in a win on Tuesday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Marquez allowed one run to open the game before he was able to settle in. He is scheduled for one more start before the All-Star break on Sunday against the Blue Jays.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zac Gallen takes loss Tuesday
desc: Zac Gallen allowed four runs on six hits over six innings with five strikeouts and three walks in a loss on Tuesday against the Padres.
impact: Gallen allowed all four runs in the first inning before he was able to settle in. He is off the fantasy radar heading into his next start against the Dodgers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Young hits home run Tuesday
desc: Cole Young went 1-for-3 with a home run in the Mariners 6-5 loss against the Marlins on Tuesday.
impact: Young took Max Meyer deep in the fifth inning. It was his third long ball in seven games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryan Woo pitches five innings Tuesday
desc: Bryan Woo allowed four runs (three earned) on nine hits over five innings with five strikeouts and one walk in a no-decision on Tuesday against the Marlins.
impact: While it wasn't a completely disastrous performance, Woo's struggles on the road continued. He holds a 6.28 ERA this season on the road.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan O'Hearn has historic day Tuesday
desc: Ryan O'Hearn went 4-for-5 with three home runs and 10 RBI in the Pirates 12-4 win over the Braves on Tuesday.
impact: O'Hearn hit a grand slam to go along with a pair of three-run long balls as part of a historic performance. He is the first Pirate ever to drive in 10 runs in a game and jumped into the top-10 in the majors with 61 RBI.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Paul Skenes earns win Tuesday
desc: Paul Skenes allowed two runs on eight hits over six innings with four strikeouts and one walk in a win on Tuesday against the Braves.
impact: After losing nine straight games that he started, Skenes finally pitched in a game that Pittsburgh won. He didn't have his best stuff, only recording four strikeouts but he pitched well enough to post a quality start. He is scheduled to face the Brewers Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: J.T. Ginn leaves start with illness Tuesday
desc: J.T. Ginn was removed from Tuesday's start with an illness.
impact: Ginn had allowed two runs in four innings before being lifted against the Tigers. It was set to likely be his final start before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ben Joyce (shoulder) begins rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Ben Joyce began a rehab assignment in the Rookie-level Arizona Complex League on Tuesday.
impact: Joyce is working his way back from last year's shoulder surgery. He should be activated at some point after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Goodman dealing with wrist injury
desc: Hunter Goodman was scratched from the lineup for Tuesday's game against the Dodgers with a wrist injury.
impact: Goodman was set to be further evaluated after he jammed his wrist during Monday's game. He is day-to-day going into Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani on track to start Friday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Shohei Ohtani is on track to start against the Diamondbacks on Friday.
impact: Ohtani was recently dealing with an issue to his biceps. It will be his final start before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryse Wilson sent outright by Cubs
desc: The Cubs sent RHP Bryse Wilson outright to Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Wilson passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will remain in the Cubs organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Jobe (elbow) throws 32 pitches in rehab start Tuesday
desc: Jackson Jobe threw 32 pitches in his first rehab start on Tuesday for Single-A Lakeland.
impact: Jobe allowed a run on 2 hits over 1 1/3 innings with a strikeout. He reached 100 mph with his fastball.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Pivetta (elbow) throws bullpen
desc: Nick Pivetta threw a bullpen session on Tuesday.
impact: Pivetta is continuing to throw off the mound. He could be cleared to face live hitters soon.
